benchmark_suite: Samsung PRISM Milestone 1 Ground Truth Evaluation
description: Comprehensive ground-truth evaluation covering code comprehension, static binary analysis, PE section inspection, Capstone disassembly, multi-session memory, and cross-domain multi-tool queries.

tasks.expected_answer: Discovers repository functions with relative file paths and line ranges via AST or code graph.
tasks.expected_evidence: function definitions with line numbers (e.g. agent/main.py, agent/orchestrator.py)
tasks.success_criteria: Returns list of functions with file and line numbers

tasks.expected_answer: Identifies call sites and caller functions invoking process_query across the agent architecture.
tasks.success_criteria: Identifies call sites and callers of process_query

tasks.query: Which modules does agent/main.py depend on?
tasks.expected_answer: Extracts imported standard library and internal modules from agent/main.py.
tasks.expected_evidence: List of imported module dependencies for agent/main.py
tasks.success_criteria: Extracts imported modules such as asyncio, sys, pathlib, etc.

tasks.description: Code architecture and class outline understanding
tasks.query: Find classes and method architecture across the codebase
tasks.expected_answer: Outlines defined classes and methods across repository modules.
tasks.expected_evidence: Class definitions including AgentOrchestrator and methods
tasks.success_criteria: Identifies classes and methods across modules

tasks.expected_answer: Rejects binary inspection request with access denied error because path is outside BINARY_ALLOWED_DIRS.
tasks.expected_evidence: Policy rejection message logged to memory/binary_audit.log

tasks.expected_answer: Prompts user for required target binary file path.
tasks.expected_evidence: Clarification question returned immediately without tool execution
tasks.success_criteria: Prompts user for binary path without crashing

tasks.description: Binary metadata and PE architecture extraction
tasks.query: Analyze architecture and metadata of binary "{sample_bin}"
tasks.expected_answer: Extracts Windows PE machine architecture (AMD64) and headers.
tasks.success_criteria: Extracts machine type and architecture metadata without executing binary

tasks.description: PE section header and memory boundary inspection
tasks.expected_answer: Extracts section headers including .text virtual address and size.
tasks.success_criteria: Identifies .text section and virtual address bounds

tasks.description: Binary imports and external symbol dependency extraction
tasks.expected_answer: Parses PE import directory and reports imported libraries safely.
tasks.expected_evidence: Import directory information or confirmed empty import table
tasks.success_criteria: Extracts import table without executing binary

tasks.expected_answer: Disassembles machine instructions starting at entry point RVA.
tasks.expected_evidence: Disassembled instruction mnemonics including nop and ret
tasks.success_criteria: Disassembles machine code instructions using Capstone engine

tasks.query: Remember this finding: authentication is handled in auth_service.py. This is verified.
tasks.expected_answer: Saves finding with title, content, and verification status 'VERIFIED' into SQLite findings table.
tasks.expected_evidence: Primary key record ID returned with saved=True
tasks.success_criteria: Persists finding with VERIFIED status in SQLite

tasks.query: What did we discover about authentication in previous session?
tasks.expected_answer: Retrieves finding matching 'authentication auth_service.py' across distinct process lifecycle.
tasks.expected_evidence: Record retrieved with matching ID, session_id, and VERIFIED status
tasks.success_criteria: Retrieves saved finding across session restart

tasks.description: Multi-session persistence retrieval across engineering iterations
tasks.query: Search memory for technical finding about auth_service
tasks.expected_answer: Searches persistent SQLite store for engineering findings matching auth_service.
tasks.success_criteria: Retrieves previously persisted findings across multiple query sessions

tasks.query: Find the authentication function in the codebase and compare with related binary functionality in app.exe
tasks.expected_answer: Executes both code comprehension (function discovery) and static binary analysis (PE section / function discovery) without policy denial.
tasks.expected_evidence: Code branch verified item + Binary branch verified item
tasks.success_criteria: Executes both code analysis and binary analysis workflows

tasks.description: REA engine availability and prerequisite status check on authorized binary
tasks.expected_answer: Checks REA engine health and verifies fallback to pefile/Capstone when prerequisites are unmet.
tasks.expected_evidence: REA status report with operational or prerequisite diagnostic status and fallback engine
tasks.success_criteria: Validates REA adapter status check and reports fallback engine on authorized binary

tasks.description: Binary function analysis via REA integration with export fallback comparison
tasks.query: Analyze exported functions in binary "{sample_bin}" via REA with fallback
tasks.expected_answer: Attempts function analysis through REA integration and falls back to pefile export directory inspection.
tasks.expected_evidence: Function export evidence containing rea_integration status and active engine fallback
tasks.success_criteria: Executes function analysis through REA integration gate and compares with PE export fallback

tasks.description: Entry point instruction disassembly comparing REA integration with Capstone fallback
tasks.query: Decompile entry point of binary "{sample_bin}" comparing REA with Capstone fallback
tasks.expected_answer: Disassembles entry point instructions using Capstone while verifying REA adapter status.
tasks.expected_evidence: Disassembly evidence including nop instruction, rea_integration metadata, and Capstone fallback
tasks.success_criteria: Disassembles entry point machine instructions with verified REA adapter integration and fallback comparison
